slice: RPP-5jx MLINE empty-pattern LTYPE provider geometry guard
scope: Connects the selected bounded empty-pattern LTYPE source/live proof to AC1021+ MLINESTYLE geometry-edit export preflight and rechecks it during finalization, alongside the existing selected LAYER and root/child dictionary proofs. The receipt does not qualify patterned LTYPEs or complete the dependency graph/output proof, enable consumed geometry, or promote support claims.

contract.selection: Runs only for a selected whole-source or legacy-identity observation profile with a modern MLINESTYLE geometry transaction. The LTYPE proof requires its admitted source grammar and provider bodies; unsupported profiles fail closed. Ordinary unobserved routes retain their existing behavior.
contract.preflight: The selected AC1027 empty-pattern LTYPE source/live proof rejects a live LTYPE description change before output publication.
contract.finalization: Finalization repeats the selected LTYPE source/live proof after writer callbacks. A test consumer mutates a provider description immediately before base finalization; the mutation causes atomic refusal and the test consumer restores the injected value after the base finalizer returns.
contract.failureAndRetry: Preflight refusal preserves the caller's provider mutation, destination sentinel and edited MLINESTYLE offset. Finalization refusal preserves destination and edited offset. Restoring the preflight-mutated provider or disabling the test mutation permits same-adapter retry. Readback confirms the selected empty-pattern LTYPE body and edited style offset.
contract.compatibility: No public API or LibreCAD callback changes. Existing unobserved MLINESTYLE transaction routes pass in the focused suite. Source/live proof work uses the configured bounded logical-work ceiling.
contract.limits: Only the selected empty-pattern LTYPE profile is admitted (at most 64 observed LTYPE records under the helper's bounded profile). Patterned/shape LTYPEs, other source versions, native rendering, all provider-to-consumer roles, other carriers and actual whole-document staged output remain open. This does not enable consumed style offsets or other refused operations.

matrix: binary DXF source -> binary DXF output
controls.readbackChecks: Unique selected LTYPE name; description, flags, size, length, alignment and path match the original selected empty-pattern provider; the MLINESTYLE retains the edited offset.
controls.sourceConstruction: AC1027 DXF source text is authored in the test; binary input is encoded locally. Provider mutations are performed in memory and temporary files are removed. No DWG/DXF fixture was added to Git.
